derived_tables.population_coverage.csv: Per-population requests/observed_users/revisits/max_revisits_observed from metadata cases; all model/scheme cases asserted equal. first_visits equals observed_users.
derived_tables.cache_and_memory.csv: Per model/scheme maximum of each audit.case_audit.peaks field and metadata.cases GPU allocator peaks over seven populations; admission capacity/reservations from audit; evictions/revisit misses summed over cases.

interpretation: HBM and DRAM budgets are artificial cache quotas, not whole-device memory limits.
NOSA HBM has 13 revisit misses among 63 revisits; offload schemes have none on this trace.
DeepSeek HBM evicts sessions but every observed revisit still hits; no measured revisit capacity benefit.
CUDA allocator peaks include model-transition retention and are not isolated model or activation peaks.
64K remains a separate pending run; no extrapolation from this matrix.
